chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfali, from Al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
ai.seo_question: What does the Imam say about the relationship between oiling and wealth?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) states that applying oil is a sign of wealth, reflecting the pre-modern context where expensive imported oils and the leisure time required for grooming were exclusive markers of the affluent elite. This narration underscores the sociological dimension of personal hygiene in Shia tradition, linking physical adornment not merely to cleanliness but to visible economic capability and social standing.
